session_row_examples_source: Real `colab sessions` rows (ids replaced by S / m-1). Each mapped (Hardware, Shape) is pinned to receipts where the SAME window's own session row and its own nvidia-smi line are both recorded (paths relative to the studio root; line numbers 1-based). Shape names the VM's host RAM; the card comes from the paired nvidia-smi line. A (Hardware, Shape) with no such pairing is CARD_TYPE_UNKNOWN. The rdlab time-one receipts (judge-bakeoff colab-runs timeone-mu / timeone-d3) record NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB in gate_status.json but no session row.
